title: fix(ai): run_sql reruns misspelt column names and keeps internal SQL out of errors

summaries.body:
## Maple review 🟢 **Confidence 8/10** · likely safe to merge Held at 8 because a warning is open. 1 warning −1 · risk medium · 1/1 new units observable `run_sql` now rewrites single-answer misspelt identifiers and reruns (up to 3 passes), reports each rewrite to the agent, and scrubs the gateway's internal SQL and org id out of warehouse error text. Safe to merge apart from one regression in how the read tables are detected. - `fixUnknownIdentifier` rewrites an unknown column to the one catalog column it can mean, then reruns - `rawSqlErrorText` strips the per-org subquery wrapper, `maple_us.`/`maple_eu.`, the row cap and the org literal - `run_sql` output gains `rewrites`, plus a notice and a rerun-count note on the following error - Catalog notes for `logs` sorting key, `traces` rollups and `service_*` dimensions corrected ### Findings
🟠 Warning · F1 · Backtick-quoted table names no longer count as referenced correctness · [`apps/ai/src/mcp/lib/sql-identifiers.ts:19-24`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/9cea5f8f297310e4a108098692e8f08e2d2c4508/apps/ai/src/mcp/lib/sql-identifiers.ts#L19-L24) `maskLiteralsAndComments` blanks backtick-quoted spans (effect-orm `src/sql/terminal-clauses.ts:44`), so for `SELECT ... FROM \`traces\`` the masked text holds no `traces` and `referencedTableNames` returns `[]`. An unknown-column error on such a query then comes back without the column list (`withColumnListOnUnknownColumn`) and `fixUnknownIdentifier` can never repair it, where the previous raw-SQL search matched inside backticks. Agents do backtick-quote, as the tool's own examples and the `` `Events.Name` `` test show. ``` Keep the masked search as the primary signal but fall back to the quoted form: `const at = masked.search(new RegExp(\`\\b${t.name}\\b\`)); const quotedAt = sql.indexOf(\`\`\`${t.name}\`\`\`); const pos = at >= 0 ? at : quotedAt`. ```
What was checked - `replaceIdentifier` spans stay offset-aligned: backtick unquoting is length-preserving and masking keeps every index - Join ambiguity handled: `owners()` requires one table for a bare or alias rewrite (`referencedIdentifiers` path) - Scrubber regexes checked against the gateway-wrapped, row-capped and datasource-permission messages in the new tests
Observability coverage: 1 of 1 changes observable | Change | Kind | Observable | Evidence | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | run_sql identifier-fix rerun (warehouse execution) | MCP tool call + DB query | yes | Rerun happens inside the existing `McpToolExecutor.execute` span and the warehouse query span path (`QueryEngineService` / `WarehouseQueryService` `Effect.fn` spans) |

## Maple review 🟢 **Confidence 8/10** · likely safe to merge Held at 8 because a warning is open. 1 warning −1 · tests covered · risk medium The new scanner reads quoted identifiers in place and counts tables only after FROM/JOIN/comma, and the rewrite rules hold on the cases I ran. One branch fixes a qualified column against the wrong table, so a joined query can be rerun onto a name that still does not exist. - `identifierText` unquotes backticked/double-quoted identifiers instead of blanking them, keeping every position - `referencedTableNames` counts a table only after `FROM`, `JOIN` or a comma - `definedNames` now captures dotted aliases, so `` AS `service.name` `` blocks its own rewrite ### Findings
🟠 Warning · F2 · Qualified fix keeps the agent's qualifier without checking that table has the column correctness · [`apps/ai/src/mcp/lib/sql-identifiers.ts:94-97`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/517593419127d007a527b922bad67543685f85cc/apps/ai/src/mcp/lib/sql-identifiers.ts#L94-L97) `identifierFix` accepts any qualifier in scope and only checks the folded column against the union of the read tables, so it rewrites `t.body` to `t.Body` in `SELECT t.body FROM logs l JOIN traces t ...` even though `traces` has no `Body` (only `logs` does; `t.severity_text` behaves the same way). The rerun then fails on a second, different name and the agent is told to "use `t.Body` directly", which is the opposite of the documented join rule. Carry the qualifier→table mapping instead of a bare name set, and require that table's own columns to contain the fold match. ``` Make `tableQualifiers` return `ReadonlyMap` (qualifier → table name), then in the dot branch look up the qualifier's table and require one of *its* columns to fold to the written column before rewriting. ```
What was checked - `identifierText` preserves length on unterminated literals, backticked names holding `'`, and `\'` escapes (ran the head file with stubbed catalog) - A table name inside a literal or used as an alias is not counted as read; `FROM `traces`` still is (ran at head) - Alias rewrites require exactly one read table to own the map column, so `errortype` on `logs` is declined

## Maple review 🟢 **Confidence 8/10** · likely safe to merge `t.body` against `traces` is now declined (checked by running the head module); the alias-declaration rewrite the new rule leaves open is untested. 1 warning −1 · tests partial −1 · risk medium `run_sql` now rewrites a column name the warehouse rejected when exactly one real column fits, reruns up to three times, reports the rewrites, and scrubs the gateway's internal SQL out of error text. The scoping fix for qualified names holds; one gap remains in what the rewrite is allowed to touch. - `fixUnknownIdentifier` folds the rejected name onto one catalog column and reruns via `runFixing` - Qualified names are fixed only from the table their qualifier names - `rawSqlErrorText` strips the per-org wrapper, row cap and org id from warehosue errors ### Findings
🟠 Warning · F3 · replaceIdentifier renames an AS-less table alias, corrupting the FROM and $__orgFilter correctness · [`apps/ai/src/mcp/lib/sql-identifiers.ts:154-157`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/10791f41e84eea1eff1aa4c620232c7428952960/apps/ai/src/mcp/lib/sql-identifiers.ts#L154-L157) `definedNames` records only `AS x`, `x AS (` and CTE names, so a table alias declared without `AS` is unprotected while `replaceIdentifier` rewrites every occurrence of the rejected name. `SELECT service FROM traces service WHERE $__orgFilter(service)` comes back as `SELECT ServiceName FROM traces ServiceName WHERE $__orgFilter(ServiceName)`: invalid SQL, and an org filter that names no table, so the rerun fails on an error the agent never wrote. ``` const written = unknownIdentifierName(message) const qualifiers = tableQualifiers(sql) // A table alias is a name the query defines: renaming it breaks the FROM and the // `$__orgFilter(...)` that names it. if (written === undefined || definedNames(sql).has(written) || qualifiers.has(written)) return undefined const to = identifierFix(written, referencedTables(sql), qualifiers) ```
### Fixed since the last review - ✅ ~~F2 · Qualified fix keeps the agent's qualifier without checking that table has the column~~
What was checked - Qualified fix now resolves through `tableQualifiers`: `t.body` over `traces` declined, `l.body` over `logs` fixed (ran the head module) - Table detection ignores backticked names inside literals and `AS`-declared aliases; masking keeps offsets so replacements land correctly - Scrubber tests cover balanced parentheses for an unaliased wrapper and an arbitrary database name

> **Backtick-quoted table names no longer count as referenced**

> <sub>F1 · Warning · correctness</sub>

```

```

> **Qualified fix keeps the agent's qualifier without checking that table has the column**
>
> <sub>F2 · Warning · correctness</sub>
